CharacterStyleRange.Content: The ferry schedule changes next week.

Paragraph 1. Harbour works continue along the eastern quay while the new pontoons are fitted. Boats will moor at the western basin, and the fuel dock keeps its usual hours through the season. Please follow the signs near the fish market and give way to pedestrians on the promenade.
